recipe:
let garment_waist: length = waist_girth + ease_waist
let garment_hip: length = hip_girth + ease_hip
let quarter_waist: length = garment_waist / 4
let quarter_hip: length = garment_hip / 4
let suppression: length = quarter_hip - quarter_waist
let dart_intake: length = suppression - ss_suppress
let side_seam_total: length = 4 * ss_suppress
let dart_total: length = 4 * dart_intake
let front_dart_centre: length = (quarter_hip - ss_suppress) / 2
let back_dart_centre: length = (quarter_hip - ss_suppress) / 2
let quarter_hem_width: length = quarter_hip + a_line_flare
let garment_hem: length = 4 * quarter_hem_width
let waist_side: length = quarter_hip - ss_suppress
let hip_to_hem_drop: length = waist_to_hem - waist_to_hip
let side_seam_length: length = hypot(hip_to_hem_drop, a_line_flare)
let waistband_pattern_length: length = garment_waist + 2 * sa_cb + wb_extension
let waistband_cut_width: length = 2 * wb_width + sa_waist + sa_wb_bottom
let waistband_fold_position: length = waistband_cut_width / 2
let waistband_finished_length: length = waistband_pattern_length - 2 * sa_cb
let wb_interfacing_width: length = wb_width
let wb_interfacing_length: length = waistband_finished_length
assert allocation_balance: eps_num = 4 * (ss_suppress + dart_intake) == garment_hip - garment_waist
assert waist_closure: eps_num = (quarter_hip - ss_suppress) - dart_intake == quarter_waist
assert waistband_length_closure: eps_num = waistband_pattern_length - 2 * sa_cb - wb_extension == garment_waist
assert waistband_width_closure: eps_num = waistband_cut_width - sa_waist - sa_wb_bottom == 2 * wb_width
let dart_leg_angle: angle = atan2(dart_intake / 2, dart_len_front)
let dart_intake_share: ratio = dart_intake / suppression
let dart_count: count = if(dart_intake > dart_intake_max, 2, 1)
